regression_tests.rationale: Verifies the updated locale loader correctly supports 'zh-HK' and does not break existing locale resolution for 'en' or 'zh-CN'.
Ensures the BFF correctly serves the new Cantonese strings for transaction, statements, and KYC screens when the 'zh-HK' locale is requested.
Validates that the KYC service's API for compliance-related text integrates correctly with the BFF when using the new 'zh-HK' locale key.
Confirms that gateway request routing and header handling (e.g., Accept-Language) still function correctly with the newly added locale.
End-to-end test that a user flow (e.g., viewing transaction history) successfully renders in Cantonese without breaking core functionality.

rollback_notes: Reverting is a code-only change, as the change consists purely of adding string resources.
Removing the zh-HK localization strings will not affect data, schemas, or core functionality.
No feature flags or external dependencies were introduced that require coordinated removal.
Rollback may require a redeploy of the mobile-banking-bff and kyc-service, but this is a standard procedure.
